scope: Native published alpha at all coarse probes of 16 near-LOD UV patterns; every pattern is coarse-positive, so fine-grid/hint fallback is unnecessary. Candidate buffer matches the complete factory proof. Alpha components are sampled opaque triangles, not welded cards; not a visual score or mip/wind analysis.

report.scope: Registered forest selected-LOD rest geometry. Leaf components link by bounding-box proximity, then leaf-surface samples test wood-triangle contacts. Alpha cutout is evaluated only in alpha mode (opaque-texel bounds); shader wind is not; candidates require visual review. Null sampled gap means no nearby triangle was found, not an exact distance.
